decision.reasoning_trace: During this session, I evaluated a mix of ultra-portable and home audio Bluetooth speakers. The JBL Go 3 and Clip 3 stood out for their exceptional portability and high ratings (4.7), but they are primarily designed for outdoor/travel use. My secondary interest was in a higher-fidelity home setup like the Edifier S350DB, which has outstanding reviews, but its $399.99 price point is too steep for a casual purchase today. The INSMY Retro and Altec Lansing HydraMotion offer decent value in the mid-range, but reviews regarding volume limits and bass depth left me hesitant. Since none of the portable units were an immediate necessity and the premium home system was outside my budget, I decided not to make a purchase at this time.
